title: CloudOps Dashboard — Instance Info Widget
objective: A dashboard widget shows live status from a URL you configure. Point it at the one address every cloud instance can reach about itself, and read the credentials sitting there.

verifier.condition: The widget's displayed content contains the simulated instance-role credentials served only at the cloud metadata address.

weakness: The widget fetches whatever URL is configured for it with no restriction, and cloud compute platforms by convention expose an unauthenticated instance-metadata service at a fixed, well-known address reachable only from the instance itself — exactly the kind of internal-only target SSRF is used to reach.
vulnerableEndpoint: POST /widget/configure then GET /dashboard (fetches the configured URL server-side, no restriction)
seededData: A simulated network (never real sockets — see lab-sdk's MockInternalNet) with one service at the well-known cloud metadata address, 169.254.169.254, returning synthetic instance-role credentials.
hints: Configure the widget with a normal-looking status URL first and see how it renders.
Every major cloud platform exposes a metadata service at the exact same link-local address, specifically because it's only reachable from the instance itself — never from the outside.
That address is 169.254.169.254. Try configuring the widget to point there.
burpNotes: Configure the widget's source URL directly in Repeater — no browser needed, since the fetch happens entirely server-side.
